verdicts.rewritten_summary: National-framework source (applies country-wide; no provincial breakdown), matching the framework claims this record documents: HRW news release, Oct 29, 2025, reports a leaked omnibus draft ("11th Judicial Package") that would amend the penal code to criminalise conduct deemed contrary to biological sex and general morality with up to three years' prison, participation in same-sex engagement or marriage ceremonies with up to four years, and would raise the minimum age for gender-affirming care including surgery from 18 to 25 with mandatory permanent infertility and repeated evaluations at government-approved hospitals. Healthcare professionals performing such interventions would face fines and up to seven years in prison, and trans people receiving deemed-illegal care up to three years. Fifteen LGBT groups and the Turkish Medical Association opposed the draft; HRW warns it would force treatment underground and expose people to arrest and pretrial detention.
